Deskripsi ProgramProgramme Overview

Siap Liga & TurnamenLeague & Tournament Ready

Tim inti akademi. Beban latihan lebih tinggi dengan periodisasi, analisis pertandingan, dan persiapan lawan. Pemain dinilai atas performa, sikap, dan kehadiran.The academy's core squads. Higher training load with periodisation, match analysis, and opponent preparation. Players are assessed on performance, attitude, and attendance.

Fokus LatihanTraining Focus

  • Periodisasi fisik & pencegahan cederaPhysical periodisation & injury prevention
  • Analisis pertandingan & video reviewMatch analysis & video review
  • Set piece dan skenario pertandinganSet pieces and match scenarios
  • Kepemimpinan & mentalitas bertandingLeadership & competitive mentality
  • Jalur seleksi tim eksternalPathway to external trials

GarudaKids FC Pembinaan Sepak Bola Usia MudaYouth Football Development

Akademi sepak bola usia muda di Sidoarjo, Jawa Timur. GarudaKids FC membina pemain muda melalui pelatihan profesional, program terstruktur, disiplin, kerja sama tim, dan pengalaman kompetitif.A youth football academy in Sidoarjo, East Java. GarudaKids FC develops young players through professional coaching, structured training, teamwork, discipline, and competitive experience.
